scope: training on the QTRP persulfidation label with the project's chemistry feature block, and one-time external validation on qPerS-SID. Does NOT touch the benchmark line: v2's three-member blend remains the benchmark model and the deployed weights 0.64/0.20/0.16 stay unchanged unless every deployment criterion below is met.
naming_discipline: no model produced under this plan may be called a persulfidation site predictor. The defensible description is a ranker of cysteines by whether a persulfidated form was detected in NaHS-loaded human lysate at pH 5.0.

primary.name: v3_pooled_ph5_raw
primary.positives: persulfidated form detected in either pH 5.0 arm of Fu 2020
primary.negatives: free thiol detected in that arm and no persulfidated form detected in THAT arm; sites called SSH in other arms are RETAINED, which is what distinguishes this cohort from the demoted arm_clean rule
primary.why_primary: raw negatives keep the detection-depth strata populated so depth stratification remains possible

sensitivity.name: v3_pooled_ph5_armclean
sensitivity.note: additionally drops negatives called SSH in any human arm; equals the existing trained-round pooled_ph5 and empties depth strata 5-7

sensitivity.name: v3_pooled_ph5_fullclean
sensitivity.note: additionally drops sites listed in the FRBM 2024 compilation, which has no site-level provenance

internal_cohorts.excluded_reason: no paired free-thiol table, so admitting them reintroduces cross-experiment depth confounding; they are used only to exclude negatives

design_notes.depth1_reference_only: confound probe; never a feature in any fitted design
design_notes.struct53_plus_zeroshot: struct53 plus the v2 chemistry zero-shot score, which carries no QTRP label and therefore cannot leak
design_notes.not_in_v3_reason: 314 positives; the ESM-2 round needed 18,458 sites to match 53 structural descriptors

outer.grouping_note: 7-mer containment >= 0.40, connected components; a declared grouping rule

used_for: dimension reduction: full, top-k mutual information with k in {64,128,256}, or feature-family aggregation

leakage_control.procedure: permute labels within component and rerun the whole pipeline
leakage_control.precedent: v2 reached 0.4992 after within-protein permutation against a true 0.8605

primary_estimand.statistic: depth-stratified concordance: within-stratum AUC weighted by n_positive * n_negative
primary_estimand.strata: exact detection depth, counted as the number of distinct human QTRP arms in which the site appears in either adduct form
primary_estimand.counting_unit_warning: depth must be counted over ARMS, never over rows: every persulfide site is also detected as a free thiol, so a row count encodes the label and reached AUC 0.9478 in the discarded first version
primary_estimand.single_class_strata: dropped; the number of positives and negatives dropped must appear in the report body

both_calibers_required.reason: the two calibers can disagree in sign - v2_chem minus pure visibility is -0.0414 within protein and +0.0307 globally - and the human QTRP cohort has too little protein redundancy for a protein caliber (18 informative proteins after crossing with depth)

reading_rules.discriminates: lower bound above 0.5 (or above 0 for a difference)

predeclared_differences_note: the last one was missed by the depth-conditioned round and has so far been measured only on the pooled pH 5.0 cohorts, which still carry the arm_clean mechanism; the single-arm raw cohorts remain unmeasured

score_versus_depth_spearman.rule: if the v3 score correlates with depth more strongly than the v2 chemistry zero-shot score does, the model absorbed the confound and must not be deployed even if its stratified AUC is higher

steps: per-class retention rate of the rule
standalone discriminability of the covariate the rule removes
only then may the rule serve as a primary caliber

precedents.demoted: QTRP arm_clean, which empties whole strata
precedents.cleared: ABPP detection matching, where the residual confound is graded and conditioning costs 0.0293-0.0346

dataset.consequence: cannot be re-searched from raw spectra; the self-controlled fallback must use PXD005168 / PXD006140 instead

tier_A_primary.negative_definition: probe-labelled free thiol (+414.19) in the Beads or Total fraction, never seen as +446.17
tier_A_primary.arms: main experiment only; MOESM7's four donor sheets contain zero +446.17 occurrences
tier_A_primary.depth_covariate: two-valued only (MOESM2 experiment count 86/44, or fraction count 97/33)
tier_A_primary.depth_stratification: NOT performed; plain concordance is reported with the two-valued covariate noted

tier_B_secondary.evidence: reductive-elution enrichment, not an adduct; MaxQuant excluded +446.17
tier_B_secondary.label_must_be_described_as: a reductive-elution enrichment label, not a persulfidation adduct label
tier_B_secondary.criterion: mean normalised H/L >= 1.30 and Significant == '+' where that column exists
tier_B_secondary.criterion_provenance: the authors' own number, applied uniformly because only the GYY4137 and Na2S4 legends state it
tier_B_secondary.negative_definition: same-sheet Elution sites below the threshold, plus bead-retained probe-labelled thiols, minus any positive
tier_B_secondary.negative_preference: same-fraction not-enriched sites are preferred over bead-fraction sites because they do not cross fractions
tier_B_secondary.depth_covariate: donor-arm count, values 1 (499 sites) and 2 (230 sites) only

external_validation.unlock_rule: external labels are read exactly once, after every internal fold is complete and the internal result hashes are on disk; the external set may not tune anything. Procedure as in protocols/BLIND_TEST_PROTOCOL_V2.md
external_validation.cross_species_gap_must_be_stated: even if the external validation passes, all of it is human; any transfer to another species has no supporting data and must be reported as unvalidated

criteria: on v3_pooled_ph5_raw, the selected chem1046 variant's depth-stratified AUC lower bound exceeds 0.65
chem1046 - v2_chem_zeroshot depth-stratified difference lower bound exceeds 0
chem1046 - depth1 depth-stratified difference lower bound exceeds 0 AND the score-versus-depth Spearman is no higher than the v2 chemistry zero-shot model's
on qPerS-SID tier A, the concordance lower bound exceeds 0.5
deployment_criteria.if_any_fails: v3 is published as a methodological result only; deployed weights stay 0.64/0.20/0.16

must_not_be_touched: the numbers in any existing report (corrections are appended, never rewritten)
environment_note: the project venv is python 3.9.6 / numpy 2.0.2 / sklearn 1.6.1 / lightgbm 4.6.0. Rounds run outside it must record their own versions in the audit, and any round that FITS a model should run in the project venv, because HistGradientBoosting defaults differ across sklearn versions.
